capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction address enrichment
source_note: Nine sold, numeric-price vacant freehold house rows from the complete first-party Savills Nottingham result grid dated 13 May 2010 were checked against official HM Land Registry 2010 Price Paid Data. Two rows were retained because each had exactly one compatible transaction matching the exact auction price, published locality, freehold tenure and house property class and completing within 180 days of the auction. The broad Nottingham row had 14 compatible candidates and six other rows had none, so those seven rows remain partial. Original appearances and provenance remain preserved; this enrichment adds no appearances and makes no new catalogue-completeness claim.

source_records.evidence_excerpt: The complete result grid identifies lot 4 as a vacant freehold house in Kirkby-in-Ashfield sold for GBP 77,000 and lot 30 as a vacant freehold house in Rainworth sold for GBP 67,500.
